[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"The short version: **an agent is a good fit for a text-mode IDE.** Its activity is already a stream "},{"id":"p38s2","text":"of file edits, shell commands, diffs, task lists, and subagents — which is what Borland built this i"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"nterface for, minus the debugger."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"This is not a chat TUI with a border. It is a window manager:"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"- **Overlapping windows with drop shadows**, because depth should be legible before you read a word."},{"id":"p40s2","text":"
- **A double-line active frame and single-line inactive ones**, so you can see where the keyboard i"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"s going from across the room.
- **A menu bar above all windows**, so no capability is keyboard-only "},{"id":"p40s4","text":"folklore.
- **A function-key strip generated from the keymap**, so the legend cannot lie about the k"},{"id":"p40s5","text":"eys.
- **A fixed single-line composer**, because a growing input box shoves the conversation around."},{"id":"p40s6","text":"
- **Modal dialogs as real windows**, so an approval prompt gets the same keyboard, mouse, and focus"},{"id":"p40s7","text":" handling as everything else.
- **Tool breakpoints**, the debugger's breakpoint moved onto the agent"},{"id":"p40s8","text":": `/breakpoint bash(rm *)` holds a matching call in a modal before it runs — `Y` once, `a` this sess"},{"id":"p40s9","text":"ion, `n` refuses and the model is told. `--deny` rules refuse without asking. `Ctrl+B` manages the r"},{"id":"p40s10","text":"ules; patterns match the one-line label the transcript shows."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"The transcript has a one-character gutter — `>` you, `|` the agent, `·` reasoning, `~` a tool, `!` a"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"n error — so the shape of a conversation is visible before its words are. Tool calls are one line co"},{"id":"p41s3","text":"llapsed and a framed body expanded, with colour-coded diffs."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"Read docs/DESIGN.md for the full reasoning, the architecture, and what is deliberately not finished."}],"truncated":true}
